srk_tea.text: Sark butter, Sark cream and a cream tea that will ruin you for all others. The scones come out at three, and everyone knows it, and every cyclist on the island arrives by ten past.
We shut at dusk because there's no light on Sark. If you stay for the stars, I'll lend you a torch. A dim one. Please keep it low, the astronomers are very sensitive.
